title: TT-SAX: A Two-Track Time Series Symbolization for Natural Language Shape Querying
abstract: arXiv:2610.30593v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Natural language querying for time series databases aims to let users find what they need in long histories of data by asking in plain language. Shape queries ask how a series moves. They are the main challenge of this task. Recent work makes them feasible by using symbolization as a bridge between the query and the long history. However, existing symbolizations were designed for compression, similarity indexing, or classification. What a symbolization should provide for natural language querying has not been systematically studied. We therefore examine the definitions of six classical symbolizations against this task and identify three limitations. (1) Direction is missing from the string, (2) direction is measured at too small a scale, and (3) the letters are arbitrary. Three design principles follow. We follow these principles and make a minimal redesign of SAX called TT-SAX (two-track SAX). The level letters stay. Each segment gain

translated_title: TT-SAX：一种用于自然语言形状查询的双轨时间序列符号化方法
translated_abstract: 面向时间序列数据库的自然语言查询旨在让用户通过自然语言提问，从漫长的历史数据中找到所需内容。形状查询关注序列是如何变化的，这是该任务的主要挑战。近期的研究通过将符号化作为查询与漫长历史数据之间的桥梁，使形状查询变得可行。然而，现有的符号化方法是为压缩、相似性索引或分类而设计的，目前尚缺乏系统性研究来探讨符号化应为自然语言查询提供什么。因此，我们针对该任务检验了六种经典符号化方法的定义，并识别出三个局限性：(1) 字符串中缺失方向信息；(2) 方向的度量尺度过小；(3) 字母符号是任意的。由此得出三条设计原则。我们遵循这些原则，对SAX进行了最小化的重新设计，提出了TT-SAX（双轨SAX）。水平（幅值）字母保持不变，每个区段……
tldr: 该论文通过分析六种经典符号化方法在自然语言时间序列查询中的三大局限并提出三条设计原则，据此对SAX进行最小化改进，提出双轨符号化方法TT-SAX，使自然语言形状查询能更好地捕捉时间序列的方向与变化趋势。
en_tdlr: The paper identifies three limitations of classical symbolizations for natural language time-series shape querying, derives three design principles, and proposes TT-SAX, a minimal two-track redesign of SAX that better captures direction and movement trends of time series.
